golem_corebands.key: {"from": "assets/mobs/arch_golem.png", "note": "THE WORKED EXAMPLE FOR `only`. arch_golem probes as three bands: warm stone at 0-60, a violet core at 270-300, red trim at 330-360. This takes the core to cold blue and leaves the stone and the trim exactly where they are -- which is the one thing `ramp` cannot do, because ramp touches every pixel.
